question: Which of the following projects is designed to provide irrigation to Rajasthan’s desert areas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi Canal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indira Gandhi Canal**, located in **India**, is one of the largest canal systems in the world, providing irrigation facilities to the arid regions of **Rajasthan**.
 
• It originates from the **Sutlej River** and the **Beas River**, with its primary function being to supply water to barren areas and support agriculture in regions that suffer from water scarcity.
 
• The canal spans a length of approximately **650 km**, benefitting districts such as **Bikaner**, **Jaisalmer**, and **Barmer**.
